basics.name: Lukas Lamster
basics.summary: PhD student at the Institute of Information Security (ISEC), Graz University of Technology. Security researcher focusing on improving runtime security through novel hardware-based mechanisms, in particular the combination of memory integrity protection with tagged memory architectures.

work.company: Institute of Information Security (ISEC), Graz University of Technology
work.summary: Exploring combinations of DRAM integrity protection and memory tagging; developing novel hardware-based runtime security mechanisms.
highlights: Exploring combinations of DRAM integrity protection and memory tagging
Developing novel hardware-based runtime security mechanisms
Multiple contributions towards memory safety, efficient memory tagging, and DRAM integrity protection schemes
Researching Rowhammer on large-scale computing infrastructure
Researching side channels and timers in Worker and Container products

work.company: Institute of Information Security (ISEC), Graz University of Technology
highlights: Improving the reverse engineering of processor-specific DRAM mapping functions
Developing compatibility layers for internal tooling
Development of drivers for assembly line equipment
